prompt:

Image 2 is generic frame03, the saved close view used as active story frame02; it anchors the immediately preceding location and visual continuity.
Shot title: A concealed filter intake glimpsed behind feathery planting.
Required camera event: Begin from the previous close view of the original pale sand path. The camera now physically slips slightly right and forward BEHIND the fine feathery green plant beside the familiar left driftwood. Nearby feathery stems cross the foreground with convincing parallax. Through a narrow gap in those leaves, glimpse a slender vertical TRANSPARENT GLASS aquarium FILTER INTAKE tube in a rear corner, mostly occluded. Only a small section of the clear tube is visible through plants, its lower end still hidden. Keep recognizable bits of the same driftwood/fern and the same cyan water. This is a discovery, not a catalog product shot. A real small 12–16 mm clear glass intake, not an oversized prop. No canister box underwater. No fish or shrimp.
Continuity: this is the SAME planted freshwater aquarium. The camera can turn, lower, lift and pass behind objects to discover new details, with genuine depth-dependent parallax and revealed occlusion. Do not merely digitally zoom/crop the previous photo, and do not rearrange the environment or introduce an unrelated aquarium. Preserve natural materials, green/cyan color balance, clear water and upper-left daylight. Natural 55mm photographic perspective with close focusing where needed; actual new camera viewpoint. Changes should follow smoothly from the previous frame while making the reveal unmistakable. The original master anchors the world, NOT a requirement to repeat its wide composition in every frame.
Rendering: premium photorealistic underwater photography, believable transparent water/refraction, real plant/animal detail, restrained bokeh, no painted or game-render look. No text, UI, logo, watermark, labels, borders or collage. No room, tank rim or ocean/coral/horizon. Add only the single subject specifically authorized for this shot; all other animals/equipment stay out of view. Preserve original assets; generate only this new frame.
